message:
The other night, we were going through our emergency supplies, and it turned into an unexpected family bonding moment. Instead of it feeling like a chore, we set up a little cozy spot in the living room with some blankets, hot cocoa, and our favorite snacks. As we sorted through our go-bags and checked our emergency plans, we shared stories about our favorite family adventures and what we’d do in a pinch. It reminded us that being prepared doesn’t have to feel heavy; it can be a time to connect and laugh together. 

How do you make preparedness feel more light-hearted in your home? We’d love to hear your tips!
